question: Should OpenClaw expose this `referenceContext` and `reference-context` lane as stable public plugin SDK surface now, make it explicitly experimental, or keep only a narrower internal Codex projection until the cross-host contract is designed?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but it changes public plugin SDK and prompt-authority semantics that automation cannot bless without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR for now, keep the linked issue canonical, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR once the API direction is chosen.

options.title: Sponsor Experimental SDK Lane
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or ask for updates that mark the lane and capability experimental and document upgrade expectations before merge.

options.title: Sponsor Stable SDK Lane
options.body: A maintainer can accept the compatibility and security commitment and proceed with this public SDK shape after final review.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this contributor PR for now, keep the linked issue canonical, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR once the API direction is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: The central decision is the public context-engine contract, and the history points most strongly to jalehman for that API surface.
